svg.text: LOWER QUAY + CITY LEVEL / z ±0.00 m
Orthographic plan • roofs removed for inspection • filled podium and inaccessible context are hatched
Same 128 × 108 m site frame on sheets 01 and 02
The quay remains a sequence of places:
or quay walk → rivet court → subway.
The market arcade leads around the
south flank to the customs threshold
and the road side of the parcel hall.
Sorting benches and a cage shape A;
Two cart doors meet marked loading bays.
S1 Public stair inside booking hall.
Upper landing joins a gallery bridge.
S2 Porters stair beside rivet court.
Rises into the mail bay at B.
S3 Staff stair: plant court ↔ upper
S4 Subway stair to island platform.
Rail crossings stay below the tracks.
Hatch: earth, podium or context mass.
Glazing is blue; it admits view only.
PHASE 1 • Revised initial spatial proposal / r03 • All dimensions and anchors provisional
Interest review: r02 promising; r03 boundary recheck pending. No AML, collision walkthrough, measurement or playtest.
